resources.string: Pick a log file to see the position fixes in it.\n\nThe reading is the same common code the JVM, Node, macOS and browser demos run — only opening the file differs, and here that is contentResolver.openInputStream(uri).asSource().buffered(). The Bluetooth tab runs the very same code over socket.inputStream.

No fixes in that file.\n\nA fix needs a position — a GGA, RMC or GLL — in the same update cycle, and one whose status field does not say the data is bad. A log of, say, depth and wind sentences alone will show nothing here, and so will a receiver that spent the whole capture searching for satellites.
This device has no Bluetooth radio.
Bluetooth is switched off. Turn it on in Settings and come back.
Reading a Bluetooth GPS needs permission to connect to paired devices. It does not scan, so it asks for nothing else.
No paired devices.\n\nPair the receiver in the system Bluetooth settings first — this app never scans, so it can only offer what is already paired.
The receiver stopped sending. It may be switched off or out of range.
